evidence.reason: `render_units` builds `templates` from recursive `ls-tree -r --name-only` entries but never checks for duplicate `source.name` values. The write loop maps every source to `output / source.name`, so two templates with the same basename (for example `crq-repair.service` and `extra/crq-repair.service`) silently overwrite the same output file and return duplicate paths. The smallest correct fix is to reject duplicate basenames before rendering or writing; unique basenames remain unaffected.
